packageRules.description: Every update type merges unattended, majors included. platformAutomerge is off because the branch ruleset requires only the always-green merge-gate check; Renovate itself merges only once every status check on the branch (checks, commitlint, validate, ci-ok) has passed.

customManagers.description: One manager owns both the manifest pin (ref and sha) and the README table row for a plugin, so a single branch carries both edits and the README sync check never sees them split across PRs.
Pins the Claude Code CLI version that CI installs, from the renovate comment above CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION.
